what: The story, told by Andy in its own voice (SeamlessM4T v2)

Andy, on the table.text: This is me, on the table. I turn to your voice, look around the room, and point.

Meet Andy.text: Hi, I'm Andy. I find what you've lost, and point at it. This is the TV beside me.

You ask.text: You ask: Hey Andy, where's my mug? I look around the room, and SAM 3.1 outlines everything that could be it.

It finds it.text: There it is. I point, check my aim with my own camera, and MapAnything tells me how far away it is.

It doesn't give up.text: Not found? I keep looking while you get on with your day, and tell you the moment it turns up.

It guides your hand.text: Can't see well? I watch your hand and talk it onto the thing, from your side: toward you, and right.

It knows your room.text: Five looks, and I know your room in 3D, your things pinned. Its shape only, never a picture.

Identical cups, told apart.text: Identical cups? SAM 3.1 Object Multiplex follows every one of them through the shuffle.

Before you go.text: Going out? I point at what you'd leave behind, and Muse Spark checks whether you'll need an umbrella.

Your language.text: I hear and speak fifteen languages. Muse Glimmer translates, on the computer beside me.

What it never does.text: And what I never do: your pictures and voice stay home, I give no health advice, and I say I'm an AI.
